steps.title: Activate ZipTip
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of C4 ZipTip Activation Buffer onto the ZipTip and discard onto a Kimwipe; repeat this 6 times.

steps.title: Equilibrate ZipTip
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of C4 ZipTip Equilibration/Wash Buffer onto the ZipTip and discard onto a Kimwipe; repeat this 6 times.

steps.title: Elute sample with p200
steps.instruction: Remove the ZipTip from the p20 pipette, place it safely back into the tip box, attach a p200 pipette (set to 200 µL) with a tip, add the ZipTip to the p200 tip, then carefully pipette the elution sample up and down 10 times per elution fraction, avoiding air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Remove ZipTip from p20 and store in tip box.
Attach a p200 pipette (200 µL) with a tip and mount the ZipTip on it.
Pipette the elution sample up and down 10 times per fraction, avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Re‑equilibrate ZipTip
steps.instruction: Remove the ZipTip from the p200 pipette, place it back into the tip box, re‑attach it to the p20 pipette, then pipette 10 µL of C4 ZipTip Equilibration/Wash Buffer onto the ZipTip and discard onto a Kimwipe; repeat this 10 times.

substeps.instruction: Remove ZipTip from p200 and store in tip box.
Re‑attach ZipTip to the p20 pipette.
Pipette 10 µL Equilibration/Wash Buffer onto the ZipTip and discard onto a Kimwipe; repeat 10 times.

steps.title: Transfer eluate and dilute
steps.instruction: Pipette the eluate into 5 µL of C4 ZipTip Elution Buffer in a clean LoBind tube 10 times, then dilute the final volume to 25 µL for LC‑MS analysis or to 80 µL for I2MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Pipette eluate into 5 µL Elution Buffer in a LoBind tube 10 times.
Dilute to 25 µL for LC‑MS or to 80 µL for I2MS.
